posts.title: Deep Learning for Tipping Points: Preprocessing Matters
posts.description: The text below is taken verbatim from Dablander & Bury (2022), which was published here. Bury et al. (2021) present a powerful approach to anticipating tipping points based on deep learning that not only substantially outperforms traditional early warning indicators, but also classifies the type of bifurcation that may lie ahead. Their work is impressive, innovative, and an important step forward.
